verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents some features of its own that run without manual effort: automated bulk outreach campaigns, a Notetaker that automatically records and transcribes interviews, and Voice AI that runs first-round interviews on the candidate's schedule. It also makes a general claim of 'replacing manual hiring tools with automation.' None of this shows a general, user-configurable automation builder (triggers, rules, schedules) running in the background; webhooks and the API are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined automation or rule builder, trigger/condition configuration, recurring scheduled background jobs, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Engage talent with automated, personalized and optimized outreach at scale
